storyCards.fact:
Kenny Chesney's "When The Sun Goes Down" reached #26 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #26 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

When The Sun Goes Down was released in 2004.

"When The Sun Goes Down" by Kenny Chesney.
